review.description: S3/S4 provide one fixture-only owned local invocation sharing exact checks only under stable admitted source, artifacts, dependencies, comparison and reviewed decisions. Recursive directory watches precede enumeration. All concrete executable/helper PATH candidates retain lookup-edge coverage; empty, relative or missing PATH and nonempty Bash startup sources reject. The supported native ABI is x86-64 glibc with explicit system library, loader, cache, lookup and bundled-module inputs. Source/helper/artifact monitors end at their final drains; independent cache/cancellation guards retain the documented later outcome boundaries.
review.implementation: Read the native plan, source/helper/artifact identities, root-before-enumeration InputWatch traversal and candidate-specific executable search watches. Indirect Bash/Node and discovered executable helpers retain watched earlier lookup candidates and symlink/absence edges. Native ABI admission inventories system plugin/dlopen modules, cached and uncached direct lookup files, hwcaps, native tools and loader/configuration aliases, rejecting alternate interpreters, custom path-qualified dependency/audit/filter contexts and unrepresented existing RUNPATH. Repeated discovery under watches binds the selected closure. The final cleanup cache guard records secondary failures without replacing an already-raised verification error or runner-owned cancellation. Exact publication rollback remains live through owner/cache teardown and final checked signal outcomes. ELF ORIGIN admission checks both original and resolved object-parent spellings against represented roots; no canonicalization can erase an alias lookup.
review.tests: Inspected all72 local verification methods and8 runner controls. New actual negative controls consume altered package source created at watch installation; run a self-removing earlier PATH helper returning zero; prove Bash BASH_ENV startup and pre-ownership rejection; send real SIGINT/SIGTERM while the owned runner controls handlers and a restored cache write is pending; distinguish success and original-error cleanup-guard events; discover actual selected glibc libc/loader/cache inputs; compile and load native shared objects by bare name through admitted RUNPATH, observing changed value9 before restored writes, uncached file creation and dangling-target creation reject evidence; reject compiled custom RUNPATH and alternate interpreters. Existing disposal, timeout, restored helper/artifact writes and later atomic receipt replacements remain asserted. No fixture evidence closes provider, real-host, sign-in or accessibility gaps. A compiled aliased shared object has an absent canonical ORIGIN lookup and a distinct existing unrepresented alias lookup; admission rejects the latter.
